subject: RFP: Compliance questionnaire submission & artifact assignments (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG)
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@helios-fin.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Helios Procurement <procure@helios-fin.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helios RFP — Security questionnaire and deadlines

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for speaking with our procurement team yesterday. Attached is the compliance pack for our RFP: a combined SIG questionnaire, SOC 2/ISO checklist, and a short controls matrix (we call it Appendix A). Our timeline is tight: responses and sample artifacts by Monday, 2027-05-17 close of business. We expect both the completed questionnaire and at least one representative artifact per control family (e.g., access control screenshot, encryption config snippet, SOC 2 report PDF).

Please confirm you can provide a completed SIG spreadsheet and identify artifact owners by Friday 2027-05-11. Also note: before we exchange any privileged reports (SOC 2 Type II, ISO cert), our legal team will want an executed mutual NDA. I can loop them in if helpful.

Regards,
Anna Lopez
Head of Vendor Risk, Helios Financial
Attachments: helios_SIG_combined.xlsx (SIG), AppendixA_controls.pdf (matrix)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@helios-fin.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helios RFP — Security questionnaire and deadlines

Team — forwarding Helios' packet. Quick playbook proposal below; attachments: SIG_Response_worksheet.xlsx (the working sheet), playbook_v1.docx (process & roles).

Proposed playbook (high level):
- Triage: split SIG into three buckets: access/identity, infra/config, governance/policy. (Karthik: infra/config + crypto; Marissa: governance & evidence packaging; Mina: access/identity + privileged access artifacts)
- Deliverables: completed SIG spreadsheet, control mapping to SOC 2 criteria and ISO clauses (crosswalk tab in worksheet), representative artifact per control family, SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 cert (redacted if needed)
- Legal pre-step: we will not send SOC2/ISO cert until NDA signed. Ask Anna to send NDA link or allow DocuSign.
- Timeline: internal draft by 2027-05-12 COB; final deliverable packaged by 2027-05-17 COB.

Can each of you confirm ownership of the buckets and whether you can deliver the artifacts listed in the worksheet? Also flag anything that requires infra/ops time (e.g., runbook exports, Cloud IAM screenshots).

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Helios RFP — Security questionnaire and deadlines

Vanessa,

I can own infra/config and crypto-related controls. I will pull the following artifacts by EOD 2027-05-12:
- KMS key policy screenshots (GCP KMS)
- Encryption-at-rest config and TLS termination diagram
- Network segmentation diagram and egress rules export
- Snapshot of runtime image signing policy (container registry)

I already have the SOC2_TypeII_report_2026.pdf and ISO27001_Certificate_2025.pdf in our secure drive (redacted versions available). I'll prepare short READMEs for each artifact indicating timestamps, scope, and how it maps to the SIG question.

Link to artifacts (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/security/hlx-rfp-playbook (access: redwood-security)

-Karthik

1) Legal redline: procurement wants a quick NDA signed before SOC2/ISO certs. Vanessa — can you work with Legal to get a mutual NDA to Anna? I can hold off packaging the reports until that's executed.
2) Walkthrough: Helios asked for a live control walkthrough. I'm proposing Wed 2027-05-12 10:00 AM PT. Anna — can you confirm? We'll prepare a focused 30-minute demo: identity/SCIM flows, key management, and change-control examples.
3) Marissa note: For the SIG spreadsheet, I'll fill the 'evidence pointer' column with Drive links and the 'confidence' column with our internal eval (High/Medium/Low).

Marissa

Vanessa, Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Helios can do the walkthrough Wednesday 2027-05-12 at 10:00 AM PT. Please keep it to 30 minutes and focus on the items Marissa outlined. Regarding the NDA: our legal team will only use DocuSign — I'm sending a DocuSign request now; you'll see an email from dse-notify@docusign.com. Once executed we'll accept redacted SOC 2 and ISO certs; full reports can be uploaded to the secure drive after the mutual NDA is in place.

Procurement note: we'll also need a formal quote and PO terms after we review the compliance package. Someone from our procurement team (procure@helios-fin.com) will follow up separately on billing/contract questions.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Anna
